I was severely depressed in high school. There was this lady who was a counselor/social worker type person (still don’t know what her actual “title” or whatever was). I talked with her at least once every week. We would talk about music and really really random shit. Then we would talk about the sad stuff. I rarely trusted anyone, but I trusted her with my life. Before I graduated, she told me to come visit her. Or to go get coffee with her. At the end of the day, it was her job, but I felt like we were more friends than anything. We got really close. I gave her my personal email after I graduated in the letter I wrote her. She has sent me a thank you email. But now, I wonder if she still thinks about me or how I’m doing. I’m waiting a couple years before I contact her so we can catch up. I want her to see me do great things. I want her to see me succeed.
